title: B1 Subordination Synthesis: Multi-Clause Complex Sentences

sections.title: Synthesizing Complex Sentences
sections.content: At the B1 milestone, speakers seamlessly combine temporal (*miután, mielőtt*), causal (*mivel, azért mert*), conditional (*ha... volna*), concessive (*bár... mégis*), and reported speech clauses into articulate, multi-tiered sentences.

items.spanish: Bár sokan kételkedtek a tervben, miután részletesen bemutattuk, mindenki belátta, hogy működni fog.
items.english: Although many doubted the plan, after we presented it in detail, everyone realized that it would work.

items.spanish: Ha nem lett volna olyan kitartó, aligha tudta volna megoldani ezt a bonyolult feladatot.
items.english: If he hadn't been so persistent, he hardly could have solved this complicated task.

items.spanish: Azért döntöttünk a folytatás mellett, mert úgy véltük, hogy megéri a fáradságot.
items.english: We decided to continue because we believed that it was worth the effort.
